# Locations & Battles

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue, also known as Spofford Avenue, is the finest residential street in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport), lined with new and luxurious homes built by millionaires alongside a unique, quaint little cottage called Patty's Place.

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is a rural community where [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), home to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Lovers' Lane are located.

**Associated with:** [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Elisha Wright](../character/elisha-wright.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Robert Bell](../character/robert-bell.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together via the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing school gossip, classmates, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head and is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), refusing to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys an active summer outdoors following a doctor's recommendation and returns to her studies in autumn with renewed vigor. Over the winter, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) prepares the Queen's class for the daunting [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid growth and growing maturity, feeling a quiet sense of loss as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is interrupted while studying [Virgil](../codex/tech.md#virgil) by her angry new neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who complains about her Jersey cow trespassing in his oats. After a sharp exchange, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pens up the cow and prepares tea for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). They discuss farm affairs and are soon joined by Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who shares local gossip about incoming neighbors and future students.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys her summer in Avonlea despite feeling a lonely ache from Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. She spends time with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) while [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) confronts the reality of growing up and leaving childhood imaginings behind. Later, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), gently warning her that they were meant for each other.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her school year and walks to the Avonlea cemetery to tend Matthew's grave. Along the way, she talks with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) about his mother, imagination, and school life. At the graveyard, after placing flowers on Matthew's and Hester Gray's graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and they walk home together discussing teaching, future goals, and friendship.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

## Beechwood {#beechwood}

Beechwood is the residence of [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), located in town, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays while taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams.

**Associated with:** [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md)

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in Lover's Lane with news that her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) has invited them both to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting Marilla's permission, the girls travel to town, stay at Aunt Josephine's grand house, and enjoy several days of exciting sights, including horse races, a balloon ascension, a concert, and late-night ice cream before returning home.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a narrow, scenic woodland trail fringed with white birches and wild flora that runs through Mr. Bell's woods to the main road, serving as part of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's picturesque route to school.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the schoolhouse, where she forgets her prepared speech but quietly observes her pupils, bonding instantly with young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After dealing with minor classroom disruptions and a visit from the eccentric Mrs. Donnell regarding her children's names, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives orchids from [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) on her walk home. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discuss the day's events, including Anthony Pye's stubborn dislike of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a place in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where both [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) were born.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md)

> During her pleasant visit to Bolingbroke with [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits the small yellow house where she was born and learns more about her parents from the current resident. The woman hands [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a bundle of old love letters written by her parents, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reads reverently after visiting their grave. Reading the letters makes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feel truly connected to her parents for the first time in her life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a noisy, crowded big city where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray worked for a winter, meeting his wife Hester Murray while she was working in a store, and to which he later returned after her death.

**Associated with:** [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md)

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location eight miles from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a train station house with a long platform and a small hotel with a yard.

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the Bright River station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, but finds a young orphan girl waiting for him instead. Rather than telling her immediately about the mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agrees to drive her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and lets her chatter happily as they begin their journey.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

## Camelot {#camelot}

Camelot is a romantic, historical setting featured in Tennyson's poetry, which [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) envies for its old-fashioned romance and incorporates into a dramatic game with her friends.

## Canada {#canada}

Canada is a nation governed from Ottawa whose political affairs are a frequent topic of debate among electors like Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

## Carmody {#carmody}

Carmody is a nearby town with a school where [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) was appointed to teach, and it features shops that locals visit via a road connected to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge), and [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

**Associated with:** [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md)

## Charlottetown {#charlottetown}

Charlottetown is a location on Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) where travelers can board a train and observe the area's distinctive red roads.

**Associated with:** [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md)

## Columbia {#columbia}

Columbia, also referred to as St. Columbia, is a location with an educational institution where [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md) studies theology.

**Associated with:** [Jonas](../character/jonas.md)

## Convocation {#convocation}

Convocation is the college ceremony held following examinations at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) where graduates are capped, gowned, and awarded their diplomas by the university president.

## Crystal Lake {#crystal-lake}

Crystal Lake is a name suggested by [Jane](../character/jane.md) for a boggy pool, which was chosen by lot when she, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) named the spot during their outing.

## Dryad’s Bubble {#dryad-s-bubble}

The Dryad's Bubble is the name given by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) to a spring located down by the log bridge, surrounded by ferns and birch trees near the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood).

## East Grafton {#east-grafton}

East Grafton is a location where Miss [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) traveled to visit a seriously ill distant relative.

## Echo Lodge {#echo-lodge}

Echo Lodge is a stone house inhabited by Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth that serves as the setting for consultations and preparations leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding.

**Associated with:** [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolroom antics from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) frightens her with ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) set out to walk to a tea party in [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton), but accidentally wander down an enchanted wood lane that leads them to Echo Lodge, the home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites the lost girls inside to join her for a tea party she had been playfully imagining by herself.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a merry tea party and explore the charming surroundings of Echo Lodge with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) demonstrates the garden's enchanting echoes and explains how her young maid came by her numerical moniker. Before the girls depart, a slip of the tongue brings up [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's name, leaving Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) visibly moved and quiet as she gives them lavendar and bids them farewell.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> During lunch, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) recounts [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's misadventure at the brook, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to leave the table in amusement. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to Echo Lodge to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. After enjoying food, echoes, and conversation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) head out into a nearby pasture to pick early strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) expresses concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over Miss Lavendar's listlessness and lack of spirit, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to promise a week-long visit during her vacation to help cheer her up. After enjoying tea in the garden, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) talks with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) about her imaginary dream-boy, forming a sweet bond of understanding with her before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for Stephen Irving's arrival. When Stephen arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him and ushers him into the parlor with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) wait anxiously in the kitchen cleaning silver until they spot Stephen and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walking happily together in the garden, confirming their romantic reunion.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

## Eden {#eden}

Eden is a biblical garden referenced metaphorically to describe a perfect, idyllic paradise.

## Edward Island {#edward-island}

Edward Island, also referred to as Prince Edward Island, is a region where custom dictates that travelers nod to everyone they meet on the road.

## England {#england}

England is a distant location mentioned by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as a place far enough from the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) that adopting a child from there might yield someone quite different from local residents.

## Entrance {#entrance}

The Entrance is an examination taken by advanced students to qualify for admission into Queen's.

## Europe {#europe}

Europe is a destination that Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) and her niece, [Maria](../character/maria.md) Spofford, plan to travel to for two or three years starting in June.

## Exhibition {#exhibition}

The Exhibition is an event held in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) to which [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) invited [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit and stay with her at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood).

**Participants:** [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

Green Gables is the secluded, meticulously kept [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) family homestead in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a big, rambling house situated at the far edge of their cleared land at the end of a long, grassy lane.

**Associated with:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) observes [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly leaving home in his best clothes, which prompts her to visit Green Gables to investigate. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) explains that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy they are adopting from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel voices strong warnings and skepticism about the decision before leaving to spread the news.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives the young orphan girl toward Green Gables as she talks endlessly about her appearance, her deep appreciation for beautiful places like the 'Avenue' and 'Barry's Pond', and her joy at finally having a home. As they arrive at Green Gables, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dreads the moment [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) will have to tell the child that her arrival is a mistake.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits Green Gables and insults Anne's looks, prompting a furious, outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After Mrs. Rachel leaves offended, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes up to Anne's room to discipline her, demanding she apologize to Mrs. Rachel, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stubbornly refuses to do.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and gently persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), turning her penance into an enjoyable performance and earning Mrs. Lynde's forgiveness. As they walk back to Green Gables, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a surge of maternal affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, disappointing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who longs for fashionable puffed sleeves. The next morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a sick headache while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her plain outfit with wild flowers and attends Sunday-school alone. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts her experiences with Miss [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md), the other children, and the service to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

## Haunted Wood {#haunted-wood}

The Haunted Wood is a gloomy spruce grove located over the brook that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imaginatively populated with romantic ghosts, including a wailing white lady, a murdered child's ghost near [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), a headless man, and skeletons.

## Hopeton {#hopeton}

Hopeton is a place where Mrs. Alexander Spencer's cousin lives and the location of an orphan asylum.

## Idlewild {#idlewild}

Idlewild is the poetical name invented by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the playhouse she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) set up in a ring of white birch trees on Mr. William Bell's land.

## Island {#island}

The Island is a region located close to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), where local residents contrast its native-born populace with those from places such as [Hopeton](../codex/places.md#hopeton), [England](../codex/places.md#england), or the [States](../codex/places.md#states).

**Associated with:** [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)

## Kingsport {#kingsport}

Kingsport is a university town featuring a historical harbor bay and an old tree-lined cemetery containing the grave of an eighteen-year-old midshipman killed during an 1813 naval conflict between the Shannon and the Chesapeake.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) register at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), feeling intimidated by the unfamiliar environment and student crowd. Later, they visit Old St. John's Cemetery to unwind and encounter [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a friendly and talkative fellow student from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). The three girls quickly bond as [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) opens up about her indecisiveness, home, and college life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

> [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats exuberantly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her suitors, [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), her indecisiveness, and her new life in Kingsport. Before parting ways, they discover the grave of a midshipman from the War of 1812, which moves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deeply. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) reflect on Phil's charm and frivolity compared to [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for a walk together in the park, enjoying the autumn scenery and discussing life. Afterward, they walk along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) and admire a quaint little house called Patty's Place, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a strong connection to.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

## Lover {#lover}

Lover's Lane is a romantic pathway opening below the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) orchard, extending into the woods to the end of the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) use as part of their scenic walk to school.

## Lynde’s Hollow {#lynde-s-hollow}

Lynde’s Hollow is a depression where the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) main road dips down, featuring a home, an orchard, a quiet brook fringed with alders and ladies’ eardrops, and a view of the steep red hill road leading out of the peninsula.

## Marysville {#marysville}

Marysville is a place where Mr. and Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) moved after leaving [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), and where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) lived and briefly attended school until she was eight years old.

## Merry Christmas {#merry-christmas}

Taking place on a snowy morning, Merry Christmas was a festive occasion marked by [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gifting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a fashionable brown dress with puffed sleeves made by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) sending her kid slippers, and the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) scholars successfully staging an evening concert.

## Millersville {#millersville}

Millersville is a settlement notable for its homely schoolma'ams, where William Obadiah goes to court a woman and [Sam](../character/sam.md) considers renting a place of his own.

## Montreal {#montreal}

Montreal is a place from which Daniel Blair's sister-in-law traveled to visit her family.

## Morley {#morley}

Morley Andrews is a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school who was punished by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for driving trained crickets in the aisle during class.

## Mount Holly {#mount-holly}

Mount Holly is the beautiful, old Gordon homestead in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), where [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) lives and hosts gay gatherings for her friends.

## New Brunswick {#new-brunswick}

New Brunswick is a region where [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visited his cousins over the summer and the location of a tragic incident in which an adopted girl poisoned her family's well.

**Associated with:** [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)

## Newbridge {#newbridge}

Newbridge is a bustling little village connected by road to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), known for its residents naming a tree-arched stretch of road "the [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue)" and home to political agent [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md).

**Associated with:** [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md)

## Nova Scotia {#nova-scotia}

Nova Scotia is a Canadian region home to an orphan asylum, situated close to Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island).

**Associated with:** [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)

## Orchard Slope {#orchard-slope}

Orchard Slope is the home of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and her family, featuring a house with a western gable located up through a brook and the firs from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

**Associated with:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding day at Orchard Slope, reflecting on their long friendship as [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) heads down to marry [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then walks with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) into the parlor and later through Lovers' Lane, where they talk about their past, their mutual acquaintances, and Anne's upcoming summer plans.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes talking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and heads to Orchard Slope to apologize to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for the bed-jumping incident. Despite Diana's fears, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bravely confesses to Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and wins her over with her candor and vivid imagination. Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become close friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

## Patterson Street {#patterson-street}

Patterson Street is a street located in a slum area where the Reverend [Jo](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md) takes a position at a small mission church and settles down with his wife, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md).

## Patty’s Place {#patty-s-place}

Patty's Place is a charming furnished house located on [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport), featuring an arched gateway, a tiny garden adjacent to a pine grove, and a cozy living room decorated with braided mats, quaint china, old prints, and two unique white china dogs with green spots.

**Associated with:** [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her second term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while dealing with an unwanted marriage proposal from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) writes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) suggesting they rent a house together in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) for the upcoming school year with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as their housekeeper. After searching in vain for a suitable house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) spot a 'To Let' sign on Patty's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends return to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) for their Sophomore year and settle comfortably into Patty’s Place. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is unexpectedly adopted by a stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), the girls fail to humane-euthanize him, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to keep him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperone the household, bringing along her own cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the Sarah-cat.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take a walk in the park on a windy autumn day, reflecting on her changing relationship with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). When her umbrella breaks in a sudden rainstorm, she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who shares shelter and walks her back to Patty's Place. That evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her friends.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

> As April examinations approach, the girls at Patty's Place prepare for their studies and learn that Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) will remain abroad for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a evening walk in the park, where she joyfully reveals that she has accepted [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) Blake's marriage proposal. As they discuss Phil's future as a minister's wife in the slums, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her ideal romance with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) and her lingering thoughts of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

> The girls return to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), chatting and laughing with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as they unpack. Later in the semester, during a rainy evening, [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares melodramatic stories written during her school days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

## Prospect Point {#prospect-point}

Prospect Point is a beautiful shore location where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) spends a month of her summer at her father's second-cousin Emily's select boardinghouse, which features a mission church served by theological student [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md).

> Philippa writes a long letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from Prospect Point describing her summer spent at Cousin Emily's boarding house. She humorously introduces the eccentric fellow boarders and relates how she met [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), a divinity student. Though she tries to deny her feelings because he is ugly and serious, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) admits by the end of her letter that she has fallen in love with him.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIV Enter Jonas

## Queen’s Academy {#queen-s-academy}

Queen’s Academy is an educational institution located in town where students pursue classwork and teacher's licenses, as well as compete for honors such as medals and the Avery scholarship.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)

## Redmond College {#redmond-college}

Redmond College is a higher education institution where students pursue a four-year Arts course with subjects such as English, Classics, Mathematics, dead languages, and geometry, culminating in final examinations, [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation), and a graduation dance.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jonas](../character/jonas.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Pris](../character/pris.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at Redmond, aided by Philippa Gordon's social popularity, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gains status after leading the Freshmen to victory in the Arts Rush. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives her first batch of letters from home, including updates from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), as well as a note from [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) revealing that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been writing to her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) prepare at Patty's Place for a Redmond College reception. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) mentions that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is frequently seen with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), which secretly disquiets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After leaving the house with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at the reception and spots [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room with Christine.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

> Philippa writes a long letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) describing her summer spent at Cousin Emily's boarding house. She humorously introduces the eccentric fellow boarders and relates how she met [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), a divinity student. Though she tries to deny her feelings because he is ugly and serious, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) admits by the end of her letter that she has fallen in love with him.
>

## Rome {#rome}

Rome is a famous city whose construction [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) notes was not accomplished in a single day.

## Shining Waters {#shining-waters}

The Lake of Shining Waters is a long, winding body of water—locally known as Barry's pond—spanned by a bridge and surrounded by sand-hills, marshland, and groves of fir and maple.

## Snow Queen {#snow-queen}

The Snow Queen is the name given by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the exceptionally white, blooming cherry tree located outside her bedroom window.

## Spencervale {#spencervale}

Spencervale is a town situated ten miles from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), featuring farm properties and a quiet, green highway known as the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road).

**Associated with:** [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md), [Chester Ross](../character/chester-ross.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md)

## States {#states}

The States, also known as the United States, is a foreign country where [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) went into business with his uncle, married, and raised his ten-year-old son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), before sending him to live with his grandmother in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

**Associated with:** [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)

## Sunday School {#sunday-school}

Sunday School is a religious instructional class attended by local children, led by a superintendent such as Mr. Bell and regularly attended by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

## Thanksgiving {#thanksgiving}

Thanksgiving is an annual holiday celebrated in November, though [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) mused that it would be far better celebrated in May when nature is alive and flowering.

## Tory Road {#tory-road}

Tory Road is a quiet, little-traveled green highway in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) lined with young spruces, built by the Tory government and home to the Copp girls and [Martin](../character/martin.md) Bovyer.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) apologizes to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp for looking through her window while trying to purchase the blue willow-ware platter. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) hosts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for tea, complaining about her sister Martha, and agrees to sell the platter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for twenty-five dollars to help fund her upcoming marriage. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home down the Tory Road, laughing over the day's events as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) holds her new treasure.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

## Valley Road {#valley-road}

Valley Road is a community situated two miles from its train station, known for having good-looking schoolteachers and operating a school with a July and August summer term.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at Valley Road station and gets a ride to her new boarding house with Mrs. Amelia [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who is delivering the mail in place of her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md). During the drive, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with stories about her romantic choices, her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), and her cousin [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md), before dropping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off at [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet's home, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends a prayer meeting with [Janet](../character/janet.md) in Valley Road and observes [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), who offers to walk [Janet](../character/janet.md) home. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Janet](../character/janet.md) visit the Douglas home for tea, where they spend time with John's mother, who speaks about her failing health and her son's future marriage.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

## Victoria Island {#victoria-island}

Victoria Island is a ravishing spot discovered by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) up the brook, featuring two maple trees and surrounded by the flowing brook, which they named in honor of finding it on the Queen's birthday.

## Violet Vale {#violet-vale}

Violet Vale is a green dimple in the shadow of Mr. Andrew Bell's woods, named by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), that sits along the scenic route she and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) take to school and is said to be filled with millions of violets in the spring.

## Wayside {#wayside}

Located in a hollow in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), Wayside is the small, picturesque home of Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet, featuring an orchard and flower garden in front, a mossy roof, and a path near a dangerous marsh.

> In a letter to Philippa, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her new boarding situation at Wayside in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She describes the charmingly peculiar home, her hostess's background, and the local characters including a taciturn hired boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also teases that she is observing another local elderly love affair, though she vows not to meddle this time.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXI Anne to Philippa

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a blunt and unwanted marriage proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). Shortly after, [Alec](../character/alec.md) summons [Janet](../character/janet.md) to the Douglas home because old Mrs. Douglas is dying. Following her death, [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) proposes to [Janet](../character/janet.md) and explains he was forced by his mother's deathbed vow to keep their agreement secret for nineteen years, leading [Janet](../character/janet.md) to forgive the late woman and accept his proposal.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last

## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

The White Sands Hotel is a large establishment run by Mr. Kirke along the shore, popular with [American](../codex/factions.md#american) tourists visiting for the summer season.

**Associated with:** [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), [Louisa Spencer](../character/louisa-spencer.md)

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a benefit concert at the White Sands Hotel, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) looks on with quiet pride. [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) to the hotel, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially experiences severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. However, catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) sparks her determination, leading her to deliver a glowing recitation that wins enthusiastic applause and praise from the audience.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

## Willowmere {#willowmere}

Willowmere is a scenic location situated past Mr. Barry's back field along the romantic route that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school.
